name: webperf-mcp
description: Webperf data in Claude: open public-sector ratings without a key, your own sites and test results with one. Read-only unless you turn on ordering.
long_description:
Ask about website quality in plain language.

Without an API key you get Webperf's open data: every Swedish municipality and region with its accessibility, performance, standards and security ratings, site search, aggregate statistics and the test-type catalogue.

With a Webperf Cloud API key (Standard or Agency) you also get read-only access to your own sites: latest results and readable reports, monthly history, raw audit data, quota, private tests and audits.

The server runs locally on your machine and is a thin client over the public Webperf HTTP API. It adds no privileges of its own: every keyed request carries your personal API key, and all authorization stays server-side at api.webperf.se. It can never show data your key could not already fetch directly.

By default it exposes only listing and reading. Turn on "Allow ordering tests" in the extension settings to add order_retest, which queues new tests for your own sites and spends credits from your quota. Claude Desktop asks you before each order.

api_key.title: API key (optional)
api_key.description: Your personal Webperf Cloud API key, for reading your own sites. Leave empty to use only the open-data tools. Stored in your operating system's keychain and sent only to the Webperf API.

allow_ordering.title: Allow ordering tests
allow_ordering.description: Adds order_retest and order_private_test, which queue new tests for your own sites and spend credits from your quota (1 per retest, 15 per private page). Needs an API key. Off, the server is strictly read-only.

api_base.title: API base URL
api_base.description: Leave as-is unless you are testing against a staging environment. Must be https.

tools.name: list_test_types
tools.description: List Webperf Core test types, to interpret numeric test ids (open data)

tools.name: list_public_sector_ratings
tools.description: Every Swedish municipality or region with its current ratings (open data)

tools.name: search_public_sites
tools.description: Search public-sector sites by name or URL (open data)

tools.name: get_public_site
tools.description: Ratings and facts for one public-sector site (open data)

tools.name: get_public_stats
tools.description: Aggregate public-sector statistics (open data)

tools.name: check_api_key
tools.description: Check whether the configured API key works and what it reaches

tools.name: list_my_sites
tools.description: List the websites your API key can access

tools.name: get_site_details
tools.description: Title, address, category and current ratings for one of your sites

tools.name: get_latest_results
tools.description: Most recent test results and readable reports for one of your sites

tools.name: get_raw_check_data
tools.description: Raw underlying audit data for one test on a site (opt-in; large)

tools.name: get_test_history
tools.description: Historical monthly scores for one of your sites

tools.name: get_crux
tools.description: Real-visitor Core Web Vitals from Chrome UX Report, weekly or daily, for one of your sites

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: Test credits for a site: cap, used and available

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Site categories on webperf.se with average ratings, for benchmarking

tools.name: list_private_tests
tools.description: Private one-off test pages ordered for a site

tools.name: get_private_test_result
tools.description: Latest result of one private test

tools.name: list_audits
tools.description: Completed audits for a site and their report files

tools.name: get_audit_file
tools.description: Read one JSON summary file from an audit

tools.name: get_retest_status
tools.description: Where a site's ordered retests are: queued (with position), running, done or failed.

tools.name: order_retest
tools.description: Order new tests for one of your sites (1 credit per test). Only present when "Allow ordering tests" is on.

tools.name: get_private_raw_check_data
tools.description: Raw machine data behind one test type of a private test. Only when the user explicitly wants raw data.

tools.name: order_private_test
tools.description: Run the whole suite on individual pages of your site (15 credits per page). Only present when "Allow ordering tests" is on.
